# Preview: Sturm Graz vs Marseille - prediction, team news, lineups

Seeking their first points of the season in the Europa League, Marseille will travel to Liebenauer Stadium in Austria to face Sturm Graz on Thursday.

Both teams suffered defeats on matchday two last week, with Die Schwoazn blanked 3-0 by Bournemouth, leaving them with just one point, while Marseille lost again 1-0 to Olympiacos.

## Match preview

Two matches into the League Phase, and Fabio Ingolitsch has yet to unlock much attacking creativity for Sturm Graz.

The fourth-highest scoring team in the Austrian Bundesliga thus far (16 goals) have yet to find the back of the net in the League Phase, one of only three that have not done so after two matchdays, though they are only below the knockout phase line.

The hope is that returning to Graz will change their fortunes, with this side unbeaten in their last five home matches across all competitions, including a 6-1 domestic win versus Grazer AK over the weekend.

On Thursday, they can extend their Europa League unbeaten run at home to three matches, collecting four points in their last two such games without conceding.

At the same time, they have won their last seven home European games when finding the back of the net, a streak dating back to the 2023-24 Conference League knockout phase.

Sturm Graz won their only previous home match against Marseille, winning a Champions League thriller versus the French side in 1999 in Austria 3-2.

Europe has not been kind to Marseille in recent seasons, and that continues to be the case early in this campaign.

The 2023-24 Europa League semi-finalists have been eliminated from a European League Phase in three of their last four appearances and they are one of nine teams without a point in this competition so far.

A win this week would be their first away from home in the Europa League since November 2023 at AEK Athens (2-0) while they can also end a six-match winless run as visitors in this competition on Thursday.

While Bruno Genesio’s men have created the second-fewest big chances in the League Phase of the tournament this season, they have won their last two Ligue 1 matches, netting a combined seven goals over that stretch to move from the relegation zone up to ninth in the table.

Those two domestic triumphs occurred away from home, though on Thursday the French club could lose three successive group outings in this tournament for the first time since 2018 (four).

This week OM can claim their first Europa League triumph on Austrian soil, losing 1-0 to Red Bull Salzburg in the group stage back in 2017, with the latter beating them in extra time in the second leg of their semi-final tie (2-1) later that season.

# Preview: Lech Poznan vs Sunderland - prediction, team news, lineups

Two teams who have made contrasting starts in the Europa League square off at The Stadion Poznan in Poland on Thursday evening, as Lech Poznan play host to Sunderland.

While the Black Cats occupy a top-nine position in the 36-team table, the Railwaymen sit rock bottom of the standings after the first two rounds of fixtures.

## Match preview

After exceeding expectations and finishing seventh in the Premier League last season, a year after securing promotion, Sunderland find themselves rooted to the foot of the table after losing five of their first seven matches this term (D1 W1).

No Premier League team has committed more errors leading to goals than the Black Cats (five), who failed to register a single shot on target and had Kevin Danso sent off in the opening 17 minutes of a 2-0 away defeat to Bournemouth last weekend – their fourth straight league loss.

Another “very painful” setback leaves head coach Regis Le Bris “worried” as his Sunderland side are experiencing “a big down” in what he expects to be a campaign filled with “ups and downs”. The Frenchman can at least take positives from their first European campaign in 53 years.

Indeed, the Black Cats are one of 10 teams out of 36 to win their opening two matches in this season’s Europa League. A slender 1-0 home success over AZ Alkmaar followed by a last-gasp 2-1 comeback triumph against Portuguese second-tier outfit Torreense last week, courtesy of Noah Sadiki’s 93rd-minute winner.

Sunderland will be keen to address their leaky backline when they head into Thursday’s contest, as they have failed to keep a clean sheet in any of their last 10 away games across all competitions, conceding 19 goals in total.

Lech Poznan are one of nine Europa League teams out of 36 who have suffered defeat in both of their opening two League Phase fixtures, but they are one of only two sides to lose without scoring, conceding a competition-high eight goals in the process.

The Railwaymen began their campaign with a heavy 4-0 away defeat to Crystal Palace before losing by the same scoreline at home to Bayer Leverkusen last week – in both games they were trailing by three goals at half time.

Head coach Niels Frederiksen admitted that his players were ‘nervous with and without the ball’ against Leverkusen, and he has encouraged his players to learn from the lessons of their first two matches in which they struggled to adapt to the pace of the game against higher-quality opposition.

# 塔迪奇出战成疑，奈梅亨客战萨格勒布迪纳摩

北京时间10月23日00:45，欧联联赛阶段，萨格勒布迪纳摩将在马克西米尔球场迎战奈梅亨。迪纳摩目前以4分排名第14位，奈梅亨1分排名第27位。

奈梅亨方面，塔迪奇在10月15日对阵索菲亚列夫斯基的比赛中因腿部问题被换下，随后缺席了与福图纳锡塔德的联赛，荷兰方面的报道称球队正在谨慎处理他的恢复，不会急于让他复出。努伊汀克因脚踝伤势缺阵，桑德勒本月也受到伤病困扰，施罗伊德在三后卫体系中缺少资深后卫人选。莫尔一直受腹股沟问题困扰，切里在国内联赛轮休后预计首发。

萨格勒布迪纳摩没有确认的缺阵球员。卢卡-斯托伊科维奇在球队最近三场各项赛事中首发，预计将继续与队长米希奇和夏季新援克拉夫佐夫组成中场。门将科塔尔斯基是夏季新援，他在迪纳摩迄今两场欧联比赛中均保持零封。

# 拿下欧联杯、直通欧冠：斯帕莱蒂走出危机的方案

尤文主场迎战雷恩，眼下球队深陷联赛困境，欧联杯的分量因此变得格外重 —— 这项赛事的冠军可以直接获得欧冠参赛资格。人有时需要找到一处喘息之地，在这里重拾活力。现阶段，欧联杯就是尤文图斯唯一的利好：小组赛积分榜形势十分明朗，斑马军团两轮战罢全取 6 分。击败奈梅亨、塞尔塔拿下两连胜，过程是否一帆风顺？对阵奈梅亨还算轻松，客场对塞尔塔则踢得并不容易。但联赛战绩起伏不定，尤文已经没有挑剔的资本。明天下午雷恩做客安联球场，尤文的首要目标就是再拿三分，稳住小组头名，巩固直接晋级明年 3 月 16 强的机会。意甲联赛接连带来糟心事，欧战需要带来笑容：一路夺冠捧杯的队伍，将拿到下赛季欧冠门票。

在孔蒂纳萨训练基地，教练组反复推演，一个方案慢慢成为讨论焦点：决赛地点法兰克福，斯帕莱蒂把欧联杯称作 “二号欧冠”。就目前形势来看，尤文争夺欧联冠军的可能性，反而高于在意甲挤进前四拿到欧冠席位。换句话说，单场淘汰赛里尤文可以打出赛季代表作，但漫长的联赛竞争激烈，若是在秋季就早早丢掉争夺欧冠席位的积分红利，后续赛程会无比艰难。简言之：这条 “二号欧冠” 赛道，正逐渐成为尤文拿到欧冠资格、弥补上赛季遗憾的一条阻力更小的路。

大考

全队重心向欧联倾斜，不过本场轮换幅度会小于前两轮欧战。这场比赛对尤文来说也是一次考验：上轮对阵榜首拉齐奥的意甲比赛，终场哨响之前，看台上就已经有大批球迷提前离场。所以取胜也是一项必须完成的任务，用来修复和球迷之间的关系。斯帕莱蒂会尝试新组合，有可能首次启用双九号（双中锋 / 九号半）搭配：科洛・穆阿尼 + 沃尔特马德。边路可用人选大幅缩减：孔塞桑肩部重伤伤停；热格罗瓦不在欧足联报名名单，无法出战；博加是备选，尼科・冈萨雷斯与阿拉伊贝戈维奇竞争一个名额，整体边路储备，已经不如赛季初充裕。

等待答卷

今年 8 月新赛季开启时，很难想象 10 月斯帕莱蒂就要面临如此艰难的局面。欧联杯目前没有给尤文添乱，甚至有可能成为这位前意大利国家队主帅最可靠的帮手。乐观情况下，维卡里奥和队友们有望提前 1-2 轮锁定 16 强席位，上届赛事拿到 16 分就能跳过附加赛，直接晋级。如果击败雷恩，尤文还将面对阿尔克马尔、奥莫尼亚、贝尔谢巴工人、费伦茨瓦罗斯、皇家社会。如果后两场比赛只关乎小组排名、不决定出线资格，尤文就可以保留体力，把精力留给其他战线。斯帕莱蒂希望在明天这场比赛拿到想要的结果，一切取决于球员面对雷恩时的比赛态度。 “球队还愿意跟着我的思路走吗？对阵拉齐奥之前，我会给出肯定答案，现在我不确定……” 在输给拉齐奥的赛后，斯帕莱蒂说出这番话。如果脱离语境，这句话听起来像是认输，但这名托斯卡纳教头本意，并不是这个意思。

Aiming to end their three-match losing run, OFI Crete welcome Bayer Leverkusen to the Pankritio Stadium for Thursday's Europa League matchday-three action.

That ambition, though, will be difficult to realise given the Bundesliga outfit's unblemished start in the league phase and ongoing seven-match unbeaten streak, highlighting the uphill challenge facing Christos Kontis's men.

## Match preview

When OFI defeated Hoffenheim 2-0 in mid-September, fans of the Greek outfit could have been forgiven for celebrating the extension of their winning streak across all competitions to four matches.

That result also extended the team's unbeaten run to five matches, before a 2-2 draw with Asteras in Crete followed ahead of the hiatus.

The pause has unfortunately done more harm than good for Kontis and his players, who have suffered three defeats since the international break, losing 3-0 to AEK Athens after Aitor Cantalapiedra was sent off with his side trailing 1-0, before falling 2-1 and 4-3 to Rennes and Kalamata in Europe and the domestic top flight.

Kontis is no stranger to such a run, having seen his players suffer three consecutive defeats in May after they also endured a sequence of one win in five matches between February and March last season.

Nonetheless, the 18th-placed side in the Europa League will point to their previous victory over Bundesliga opposition, as well as a six-match unbeaten run in front of their supporters, or seven including last season's success over Volos, as proof that they can hold their own against anyone in their own backyard.

Supporters of a Bayer persuasion will point to an obvious caveat: they are in significantly better form than Hoffenheim, who have lost six of their nine matches this season.

In contrast, Carles Martinez's men have secured seven victories from nine competitive matches since August, including two wins in Europe without conceding.

Five of those victories have come consecutively for Die Werkself, who have demonstrated their expertise across various game states to move within one win of recording six in a row.

They have claimed routine 2-0 wins over Celje and RB Leipzig, held their nerve after Mainz 05 recovered from 2-0 down to draw level before an eventual 4-3 success, dispatched Lech Poznan and overturned a 1-0 deficit against Freiburg at the weekend to win 2-1.

Now, the German top-flight club's next assignment is to become the first side since Aris in May to beat OFI in Heraklion.

# Preview: Hoffenheim vs Lyon - prediction, team news, lineups

Hoping to continue their 100% start in the Europa League's league-phase, Lyon will travel to face struggling Hoffenheim at SNP Arena on Thursday.

Die Kraichgauer are still waiting for their first points of their continental campaign, but Les Gones are eyeing a fifth win in six games across all competitions.

## Match preview

Christian Ilzer's Hoffenheim narrowly missed out on Champions League football last term, but their beginning to 2026-27 has been far from impressive.

Die Kraichgauer lost four of their first five Bundesliga matches this term, a run made more concerning by the fact the team conceded three goals in each of those defeats.

To make matters worse, the German club were shockingly beaten 2-0 by OFI Crete on matchday one of the Europa League's league-phase, before succumbing to a 3-2 loss to Besiktas on home turf last week.

However, Hoffenheim were able to secure a narrow 2-1 victory over Borussia Monchengladbach on Sunday, but it should be noted that Die Fohlen are sat at the bottom of the Bundesliga table with zero points, so anything other than a win would have been seen as disastrous.

Supporters will be searching for any positive to take into Thursday's showdown, but the hosts have been beaten in three of their four matches at SNP Arena this season, only coming out on top 2-1 against Stuttgart on September 12.

That being said, Hoffenheim lost each of those clashes by a single goal, scoring twice in all of their outings on home turf, so expect to see a competitive performance by Die Kraichgauer.

Meanwhile, Paulo Fonseca's Lyon have been impressive so far this season, and will be confident of taking maximum points on Thursday.

Les Gones currently sit at the top of Ligue 1 with 14 points after seven games, ahead of Paris Saint-Germain on goal difference having lost just once in France's top flight.

Most recently, Fonseca's men came from behind to beat Nice 2-1 on Sunday, when Pavel Sulc and Tanner Tessmann responded to Elye Wahi's early opener by scoring twice in four first-half minutes.

That victory marked a fourth in five outings for Lyon, a run that began with a 2-1 triumph over Anderlecht on the Europa League's first matchday.

The French side followed that continental success with another on October 15, when they ran out deserving 3-2 winners against Crystal Palace, racking up 2.05 expected goals at Parc Olympique Lyonnais.
